title: FRED, ALFRED and GeoFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
agency: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
questions: how big is the output gap
net interest as a share of GDP by fiscal year
how much was 2020 Q2 GDP revised
when is the next CPI release

key_only: source agency, notes and copyright status of each series

limits.note: API: 120 requests a minute, 100,000 observations per call (paged). Graph downloads: at most 12 series per graph (more are silently dropped); fetch.py sends one series per CSV.

manual.how: Run --manual-bundle (or follow --check): <out>/manual_download/fred/INSTRUCTIONS.md lists one browser link per series (fredgraph.csv / alfredgraph.csv, no key; or the series page's Download button, CSV) and download_fred.sh / .ps1 with the request built in (one command each, e.g. bash ~/Downloads/download_fred.sh), which fetch everything, asking for a key with hidden input only for key-only files. Send INSTRUCTIONS.md, both scripts and spec.json; the user uploads the files unchanged, then run --ingest.

cache.why: FRED's terms of use forbid storing or caching FRED content beyond what a use needs and building an archive of it; only the analysis folder's own data/fred/ copy for this request is kept.

redistribution.why: FRED's terms (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/) let users share public-domain series with a citation and copyrighted series marked Citation Required with the owner's citation; series marked Copyrighted: Pre-Approval Required (S&P, some Moody's and ICE indexes) may not be republished without the owner's written permission, so their rows are withheld from shared files.

notices: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
citation: {dataset}, retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis; https://fred.stlouisfed.org/, {retrieved_long}. Per-series citations are in data/fred/series.csv.

audit_hooks.why: The retrieval date, route and vintage of each series must be stated; request.json records them.
FRED's terms ask that each series be cited; series.csv holds the citation and copyright status (regional.csv, for GeoFRED-only specs, the group titles).

any: not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
audit_hooks.why: FRED's API terms of use require this notice in any product that uses the API (route api in data/fred/request.json).
FRED's suggested citation names FRED and the retrieval date.

clarify: Calendar or fiscal years? Default: fiscal years (October to September) for budget amounts and their shares of GDP (fiscal-year GDP = mean of the four quarters); calendar years otherwise.
Which vintage: latest data, as published on a date, or as first reported? Default: latest, unless the question is about what was known at a time; then the vintage just before it.

Which measure (PCE or CPI; debt held by the public or total public debt; budget-basis or NIPA interest)? Default: the measure the question's institution uses; indexing questions use the index the law names.

Which growth measure (Q4 over Q4, annual average, quarterly annualized)? Default: the publishing agency's own measure: BEA's annual growth is annual average over annual average (Q4 over Q4 only when comparing with Fed or CBO projections, which use it); annual averages for rates; name it every time.
